detailed_description: Port Scanner is a comprehensive reference tool for network administrators and developers to look up common network ports and their associated services. The tool provides detailed information about well-known ports (0-1023), registered ports (1024-49151), and dynamic/private ports (49152-65535). You can search by port number or service name to quickly find information about protocols like HTTP, HTTPS, SSH, FTP, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and many more. This reference guide is essential for network configuration, firewall setup, and troubleshooting connectivity issues. Note: This is a reference tool that provides port information; actual port scanning requires remote implementation for security reasons.
usage_steps: Use the search box to find ports by number or service name
Enter a specific port number in the lookup field for detailed info
Browse the common ports reference table
View port ranges and their classifications
Use the information for network configuration and troubleshooting
